same_hand_exclusion: all same-side L_/R_ finger and same-side wrist combinations; pending coverage approval
static_rule: equal moving ancestor joint id sets; report separately; reject variation of library-constant joints
budget_exhaustion: TIMEOUT or explicit incomplete validation; never PASS_SIM
completion_rule: all declared curves, kept word slices and boundary instants covered at requested grid and coordinate bounds; all measurements finite; hashes and approved scope match
unknown_representation: ERROR; do not interpolate unknown data
retiming_rule: reconstruct and revalidate the final timed curve after every retiming or shortcut
